job_description:
We are looking for an experienced Aviation Maintenance professional 
specializing in electronics and electrical systems (Avionics) to join our 
technical operations team. You will be responsible for the inspection, 
troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of aircraft avionics and 
electrical systems, as well as simulator equipment.

Key Responsibilities:
- Perform advanced troubleshooting and repair of aviation electronics 
  and electrical systems.
- Execute scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on aircraft components 
  in accordance with regulatory standards.
- Maintain, calibrate, and upgrade flight simulator equipment.
- Read and interpret complex technical manuals, wiring diagrams, and 
  schematics to perform precise repairs.
- Document all maintenance activities accurately to ensure compliance 
  with safety and aviation regulations.
- Provide technical guidance or supervision to junior technicians 
  during complex repair operations.

The ideal candidate has significant hands-on experience in aviation 
maintenance, strong analytical skills for electronics troubleshooting, 
and a deep understanding of aviation safety protocols.
